instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for a dermatologist in Sydney, open a clinic website, find the clinic's contact details, and save the details in a text file named dermatologist_contact.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for a dermatologist in Sydney.
Open one dermatologist clinic website from the search results.
Type the clinic name and contact details into the file.
Save the file as dermatologist_contact.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
